type_definitions.definition: An official body or group of individuals empowered to govern or administer public affairs.

A numerical quantity representing a count of individuals.
A ship or large boat.
A large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.
A commercial business enterprise.
A town or city with a harbor where ships load or unload, or a place where boats can dock.
A numerical measurement of the space between two points.
A large and densely populated urban area.
A person holding an office in a government.
An individual human being.
A physical or mental feature that is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly a disease that is not apparent to the patient.
A principal administrative division of certain countries or empires.
An institution providing medical and surgical treatment and nursing care for sick or injured people.
A department of a government, usually headed by a minister.
An organization with an international membership, scope, or presence.
A room or building equipped for scientific experiments, research, or teaching, or for the manufacture of drugs or chemicals.
The length of time that something continues or exists.
A collection of individuals sharing a common profession or job.
A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.
A specific day, month, and year.
A geographical area designated for health administration and service delivery.
A permanent or semi-permanent organization in the machinery of government responsible for the oversight and administration of specific functions.
A level of quality or attainment, or a set of rules or principles used as a basis for judgment.
A group of professionals dedicated to protecting and improving the health of communities.
A sudden increase in occurrences of a disease in a particular time and place.
A genetic variant or subtype of a virus.
The management and care of a patient to combat disease or disorder.
A substance used to stimulate the production of antibodies and provide immunity against one or several diseases.
A research study conducted to evaluate a medical, surgical, or behavioral intervention in human participants.
An event describing a general direction in which something is developing or changing.
A place, person, or thing from which information comes or can be obtained.
A numerical count of instances of a particular disease or condition.
A numerical count of fatalities.
An individual instance of a disease.
A numerical count of individuals receiving medical care.
A numerical count of administrative provinces.
A numerical count of individuals who have recovered from an illness.
An action taken in advance to prepare for something.
A set of actions or strategies implemented to manage or combat a disease outbreak.
An action or policy implemented to protect and improve community health.
The ability of a public health system to perform its functions effectively.
A place or point where one can enter.
